scenarios.name: Find origin axes with different query capitalization

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
its model browser contains X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis under Origin
the user opens browser search and enters "axis"
the browser displays X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis under Origin
the user clears the search and closes the empty search field
the unfiltered browser tree is displayed
